title: Divergence: spec_call_param_cast dedupe suffix heuristic (ends_with 'as <cast>') skips the REQ-5 narrowing on an int-typed arg whose lowering merely ENDS in a cast — req s_dec(k + j as u32) emits un-narrowed int arg, E0308 -> correct source dies at L0 (live-confirmed); shared by lower_expr Call arm (both branches) + the c116360c lower_inv_expr Call arm

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Failing tests at thermite-lower/tests/divergence_spec_call_cast_dedupe_suffix.rs (2 pins, #[ignore]d, tracking this issue) demonstrate the divergence. Authority: verus-lowering.md REQ-5 — an ARITHMETIC spec-call arg is the unbounded int in spec position and must narrow to the callee's DECLARED param type; the textual ends_with('as u32') check matches 'k + j as u32' = 'k + (j as u32)' (u32+u32 -> int as a whole) and skips the cast. Live: forge check on the fn-req fixture -> s_dec L3, f L0, E0308 'expected u32, found int'. Hand verus on the struct-inv twin emission s_a(self.x + self.y as u32): same E0308. Pre-existing in the #225 mechanism (lower_expr Call arm, both cast branches), copied verbatim into c116360c's lower_inv_expr Call arm — NOT introduced by c116360c, but reachable from correct surface syntax on every threaded site.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Replace the textual dedupe (lowered.ends_with('as <cast>')) with a structural condition at all 3 spec_call_param_cast consumers (lower_inv_expr Call arm; lower_expr Call arm arith + nat-len branches). New helper arg_is_toplevel_cast_to(arg, cast): skip the REQ-5 narrowing iff the arg AST is top-level Expr::Cast{ty} with lower_type(ty)==cast (a genuine re-narrow ((x) as u32)). A Binary/Unary or .len() arg is never a top-level cast -> always narrowed, fixing the k + j as u32 = k + (j as u32) int-typed false-skip (E0308 -> L0). Goldens stable: top-level-cast arg s(x as u32) still emits ONE cast.
